about: DO NOT MERGE. Owed 87's adapter mutants (the owner, 2026-10-24, "A": the stall rule retired, rtmp2sink's own timeout the one detector, set from domain::config::OUTPUT_SINK_TIMEOUT_MS). Each is an exact-text replace that must match once. The named test runs unmutated first (it must pass), then mutated (it must FAIL by name). A1 removes the set: only the non-default readback can see it, since the production value equals rtmp2sink's default. A2 moves the constant to 20 s: the default's pin reds (C14's m9 runs the same change on case 17, in c14-mutants). A3 hands the programme a timeout other than the domain's: the per-sink readback reds.
